  // offset of block t in the local buffer (owner only)\n    size_t localElems = 0;     // total local elements\n\n    void build(size_t n_, size_t b_, int rank, int size) {\n        n = n_;\n        b = b_;\n        nb = (int)((n + b - 1) / b);\n        rows.resize(nb);\n        cols.resize(nb);\n        off.assign(nb, 0);\n        size_t acc = 0;\n        for (int t = 0; Returns -1 on success, otherwise the index of the\n// first non positive definite diagonal element.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic int factorUpperBlock(double* D, const size_t m, const size_t ld) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < m; ++j) {\n        const double d = D[j + j * ld];\n        if (!(d > 0.0)) {\n            return (int)j;\n        }\n        const double r = sqrt(d);\n        D[j + j * ld] = r;\n\n        for (size_t l = j + 1; l < m; ++l) {\n            D[j + l * ld] /= r;\n        }\n\n        // Rank-1 update of the trailing upper triangle.\n        const long long lbeg = (long long)j + 1;\n        const long long lend = (long long)m;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (lend - lbeg > 48)\n        for (long long l = lbeg; l < lend; ++l) {\n            const double djl = D[j + (size_t)l * ld];\n            double* __restrict__ col = D + (size_t)l * ld;\n            const double* __restrict__ rowj = D + j;\n            for (size_t i = j + 1; i <= (size_t)l; ++i) {\n                col[i] -= rowj[i * ld] * djl;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return -1;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Generate the local block columns of the symmetric positive definite matrix.\n//\n// Mirrors the reference generator exactly: A = B * B^T + n * I with B filled\n// from rand_r(seed = 42).  The k-summation order is preserved, so the produced\n// matrix is bit-for-bit identical to the sequential version.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic void generateLocal(double* Aloc, const BlockLayout& L) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Flat list of the local columns (global column index + destination).\n    struct Col {\n        size_t gj;\n        size_t dst;\n        size_t nrows;\n    };\n    std::vector<Col> cols;\n    for (int t = 0; t < L.nb; ++t) {\n        if (t % g_size != g_rank) continue;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < L.cols[t]; ++j) {\n            cols.push_back({(size_t)t * L.b + j, L.off[t] + j * L.rows[t], L.rows[t]});\n        }\n    }\n\n    const long long nc = (long long)cols.size();\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 4)\n    for (long long c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        const Col& col = cols[(size_t)c];\n        const double* __restrict__ bj = B.data() + col.gj * n;\n        double* __restrict__ dst = Aloc + col.dst;\n\n        size_t i = 0;\n        // Four independent dot products at a time: preserves the summation\n        // order of each individual dot product while exposing ILP.\n        for (; i + 4 <= col.nrows; i += 4) {\n            const double* __restrict__ b0 = B.data() + (i + 0) * n;\n            const double* __restrict__ b1 = B.data() + (i + 1) * n;\n            const double* __restrict__ b2 = B.data() + (i + 2) * n;\n            const double* __restrict__ b3 = B.data() + (i + 3) * n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                const double v = bj[k];\n                s0 += b0[k] * v;\n                s1 += b1[k] * v;\n                s2 += b2[k] * v;\n                s3 += b3[k] * v;\n            }\n            dst[i + 0] = s0;\n            dst[i + 1] = s1;\n            dst[i + 2] = s2;\n            dst[i + 3] = s3;\n        }\n        for (; i < col.nrows; ++i) {\n            const double* __restrict__ b0 = B.data() + i * n;\n            double s0 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                s0 += b0[k] * bj[k];\n            }\n            dst[i] = s0;\n        }\n\n        // Diagonal dominance (A[gj][gj] += n).\n        dst[col.gj] += (double)n;\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Validation: compute L * L^T and compare against the original matrix.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic bool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig,\n                             const size_t n) {\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 8) reduction(max : maxError, relError)\n    for (long long ii = 0; ii < (long long)n; ++ii) {\n        const size_t i = (size_t)ii;\n        const double* __restrict__ Li = L.data() + i * n;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double* __restrict__ Lj = L.data() + j * n;\n            // L is lower triangular: entries beyond min(i, j) are exactly zero.\n            const size_t kmax = std::min(i, j) + 1;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < kmax; ++k) {\n                sum += Li[k] * Lj[k];\n            }\n            const double error = fabs(sum - A_orig[i * n + j]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i * n + j]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nstatic void printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_size);\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (g_rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (g_rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --- Node-local setup: one GPU per rank, CPU cores split between ranks ---\n    MPI_Comm shmComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, g_rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &shmComm);\n    int localRank = 0, localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(shmComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(shmComm, &localSize);\n\n    // Give every node-local rank an equal, disjoint share of the node's cores.\n    // This makes the hybrid code independent of the launcher's default binding\n    // (which often pins a whole rank to a single core).\n    {\n        const int nCpus = (int)sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN);\n        const int share = std::max(1, nCpus / localSize);\n        const int first = (localRank * share) % std::max(1, nCpus);\n        cpu_set_t* set = CPU_ALLOC(nCpus);\n        const size_t setSize = CPU_ALLOC_SIZE(nCpus);\n        CPU_ZERO_S(setSize, set);\n        for (int c = 0; c < share; ++c) {\n            CPU_SET_S((first + c) % nCpus, setSize, set);\n        }\n        if (sched_setaffinity(0, setSize, set) != 0 && g_rank == 0) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"Warning: could not set CPU affinity\\n\");\n        }\n        CPU_FREE(set);\n\n        if (getenv(\"OMP_NUM_THREADS\") == nullptr) {\n            omp_set_num_threads(std::max(1, std::min(share, omp_get_num_procs())));\n        }\n    }\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        if (g_rank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));\n\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d, OpenMP threads/rank: %d, GPUs/node: %d\\n\", g_size,\n               omp_get_max_threads(), deviceCount);\n    }\n\n    if (n == 0) {\n        if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Computation time: 0 ms\\n\");\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    // --- Layout ---\n    size_t b = (n >= 2048) ? 256 : 128;\n    b = std::min(b, n);\n    BlockLayout lay;\n    lay.build(n, b, g_rank, g_size);\n    const int nb = lay.nb;\n\n    // --- Matrix generation (distributed, OpenMP parallel) ---\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n\n    std::vector<double> hostLoc(lay.localElems ? lay.localElems : 1);\n    generateLocal(hostLoc.data(), lay);\n\n    // Local element counts / displacements for the final (and optional\n    // original-matrix) gather.\n    std::vector<int> gCounts(g_size), gDispls(g_size);\n    {\n        int myCount = (int)lay.localElems;\n        MPI_Allgather(&myCount, 1, MPI_INT, gCounts.data(), 1, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        int acc = 0;\n        for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) {\n            gDispls[p] = acc;\n            acc += gCounts[p];\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> A;       // full result (rank 0)\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;  // original matrix (rank 0, validation only)\n    std::vector<double> gBuf;    // gather receive buffer (rank 0)\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        size_t total = 0;\n        for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) total += (size_t)gCounts[p];\n        gBuf.resize(total ? total : 1);\n    }\n\n    if (validate) {\n        MPI_Gatherv(hostLoc.data(), (int)lay.localElems, MPI_DOUBLE, gBuf.data(), gCounts.data(),\n                    gDispls.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (g_rank == 0) {\n            A_orig.resize(n * n);\n            for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) {\n                size_t src = (size_t)gDispls[p];\n                for (int t = p; t < nb; t += g_size) {\n                    const size_t rt = lay.rows[t];\n                    const size_t ct = lay.cols[t];\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n                    for (long long jj = 0; jj < (long long)ct; ++jj) {\n                        const size_t gj = (size_t)t * lay.b + (size_t)jj;\n                        const double* col = gBuf.data() + src + (size_t)jj * rt;\n                        for (size_t i = 0; i < rt; ++i) {\n                            A_orig[i * n + gj] = col[i];\n                            A_orig[gj * n + i] = col[i];  // symmetric\n                        }\n                    }\n                    src += rt * ct;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --- GPU / communication resources ---\n    cudaStream_t stream;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&stream));\n    cublasHandle_t handle;\n    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasCreate(&handle));\n    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasSetStream(handle, stream));\n    cudaEvent_t panelEvent;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&panelEvent, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n\n    double* dLoc = nullptr;\n    double* dW = nullptr;\n    double* dDiag = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dLoc, std::max<size_t>(lay.localElems, 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dW, b * n * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dDiag, b * b * sizeof(double)));\n\n    double* hSend = nullptr;\n    double* hRecv = nullptr;\n    double* hDiag = nullptr;\n    double* hBcast = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hSend, b * n * sizeof(double), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hRecv, b * n * sizeof(double), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hDiag, b * b * sizeof(double), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hBcast, (b * b + 1) * sizeof(double), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n\n    std::vector<int> counts(g_size), displs(g_size);\n    std::vector<size_t> srcOff(nb);\n\n    const double one = 1.0;\n    const double negone = -1.0;\n\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    if (lay.localElems) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dLoc, hostLoc.data(), lay.localElems * sizeof(double),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n    }\n\n    int failIndex = -1;\n\n    // Factor the very first diagonal block.\n    {\n        const size_t m0 = lay.cols[0];\n        if (g_rank == 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(hDiag, m0 * sizeof(double), dLoc, lay.rows[0] * sizeof(double),\n                                         m0 * sizeof(double), m0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));\n            const int bad = factorUpperBlock(hDiag, m0, m0);\n            memcpy(hBcast, hDiag, m0 * m0 * sizeof(double));\n            hBcast[m0 * m0] = (double)bad;\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(hBcast, (int)(m0 * m0 + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (hBcast[m0 * m0] >= 0.0) failIndex = (int)hBcast[m0 * m0];\n        if (failIndex < 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dDiag, hBcast, m0 * m0 * sizeof(double),\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n            if (g_rank == 0) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(dLoc, lay.rows[0] * sizeof(double), hBcast,\n                                             m0 * sizeof(double), m0 * sizeof(double), m0,\n                                             cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < nb && failIndex < 0; ++k) {\n        const size_t bk = lay.cols[k];\n        const size_t c0 = (size_t)(k + 1) * lay.b;\n        if (k + 1 >= nb) break;\n\n        // 1) Triangular solve for the block row k of every locally owned block\n        //    column t > k:  R[k,t] = R[k,k]^-T * A[k,t]\n        for (int t = k + 1; t < nb; ++t) {\n            if (t % g_size != g_rank) continue;\n            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDtrsm(handle, CUBLAS_SIDE_LEFT, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_UPPER, CUBLAS_OP_T,\n                                     CUBLAS_DIAG_NON_UNIT, (int)bk, (int)lay.cols[t], &one, dDiag,\n                                     (int)bk, dLoc + lay.off[t] + (size_t)k * lay.b,\n                                     (int)lay.rows[t]));\n        }\n\n        // 2) Exchange the freshly computed block row k among all ranks.\n        {\n            size_t sOff = 0;\n            for (int t = k + 1; t < nb; ++t) {\n                if (t % g_size != g_rank) continue;\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(hSend + sOff, bk * sizeof(double),\n                                             dLoc + lay.off[t] + (size_t)k * lay.b,\n                                             lay.rows[t] * sizeof(double), bk * sizeof(double),\n                                             lay.cols[t], cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));\n                sOff += bk * lay.cols[t];\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));\n\n            int acc = 0;\n            for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) {\n                int c = 0;\n                for (int t = p; t < nb; t += g_size) {\n                    if (t > k) c += (int)(bk * lay.cols[t]);\n                }\n                counts[p] = c;\n                displs[p] = acc;\n                acc += c;\n            }\n            MPI_Allgatherv(hSend, counts[g_rank], MPI_DOUBLE, hRecv, counts.data(), displs.data(),\n                           MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n            for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) {\n                size_t off = (size_t)displs[p];\n                for (int t = p; t < nb; t += g_size) {\n                    if (t <= k) continue;\n                    srcOff[t] = off;\n                    off += bk * lay.cols[t];\n                }\n            }\n            for (int t = k + 1; t < nb; ++t) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dW + (size_t)t * lay.b * bk, hRecv + srcOff[t],\n                                           bk * lay.cols[t] * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 3) Trailing update with one-step lookahead: the next panel is updated\n        //    and factorized first so that its broadcast overlaps with the\n        //    remaining GPU work.\n        const int next = k + 1;\n        const int root = next % g_size;\n        const size_t mn = lay.cols[next];\n\n        auto gemmBlock = [&](int t) {\n            const size_t m = lay.rows[t] - c0;\n            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(handle, CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_OP_N, (int)m, (int)lay.cols[t],\n                                     (int)bk, &negone, dW + c0 * bk, (int)bk,\n                                     dW + (size_t)t * lay.b * bk, (int)bk, &one,\n                                     dLoc + lay.off[t] + c0, (int)lay.rows[t]));\n        };\n\n        MPI_Request req;\n        if (g_rank == root) {\n            gemmBlock(next);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(hDiag, mn * sizeof(double),\n                                         dLoc + lay.off[next] + c0, lay.rows[next] * sizeof(double),\n                                         mn * sizeof(double), mn, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(panelEvent, stream));\n\n            for (int t = next + 1; t < nb; ++t) {\n                if (t % g_size == g_rank) gemmBlock(t);\n            }\n\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(panelEvent));\n            const int bad = factorUpperBlock(hDiag, mn, mn);\n            memcpy(hBcast, hDiag, mn * mn * sizeof(double));\n            hBcast[mn * mn] = (double)bad;\n            MPI_Ibcast(hBcast, (int)(mn * mn + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, root, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req);\n\n            if (bad < 0) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dDiag, hBcast, mn * mn * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(dLoc + lay.off[next] + c0,\n                                             lay.rows[next] * sizeof(double), hBcast,\n                                             mn * sizeof(double), mn * sizeof(double), mn,\n                                             cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n            }\n            MPI_Wait(&req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        } else {\n            MPI_Ibcast(hBcast, (int)(mn * mn + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, root, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req);\n            for (int t = k + 1; t < nb; ++t) {\n                if (t % g_size == g_rank) gemmBlock(t);\n            }\n            MPI_Wait(&req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            if (hBcast[mn * mn] < 0.0) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dDiag, hBcast, mn * mn * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (hBcast[mn * mn] >= 0.0) {\n            failIndex = (int)((size_t)next * lay.b + (size_t)hBcast[mn * mn]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));\n\n    bool success = (failIndex < 0);\n    if (!success) {\n        if (g_rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\\n\", failIndex);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --- Gather the distributed factor and rebuild row-major lower L ---\n    if (success) {\n        if (lay.localElems) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostLoc.data(), dLoc, lay.localElems * sizeof(double),\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n        MPI_Gatherv(hostLoc.data(), (int)lay.localElems, MPI_DOUBLE, gBuf.data(), gCounts.data(),\n                    gDispls.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (g_rank == 0) {\n            A.resize(n * n);\n            for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) {\n                size_t src = (size_t)gDispls[p];\n                for (int t = p; t < nb; t += g_size) {\n                    const size_t rt = lay.rows[t];\n                    const size_t ct = lay.cols[t];\n                    const size_t base = src;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n                    for (long long jj = 0; jj < (long long)ct; ++jj) {\n                        const size_t gj = (size_t)t * lay.b + (size_t)jj;\n                        const double* col = gBuf.data() + base + (size_t)jj * rt;\n                        // Column gj of the column-major upper factor is row gj\n                        // of the row-major lower factor.\n                        memcpy(A.data() + gj * n, col, (gj + 1) * sizeof(double));\n                        // Zero out upper triangular part.\n                        if (gj + 1 < n) {\n                            memset(A.data() + gj * n + gj + 1, 0, (n - gj - 1) * sizeof(double));\n                        }\n                    }\n                    src += rt * ct;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    // --- Cleanup of GPU resources ---\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hSend));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hRecv));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hDiag));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hBcast));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dLoc));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dW));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dDiag));\n    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDestroy(handle));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(panelEvent));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));\n    MPI_Comm_free(&shmComm);\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n\n        const double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n        const double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", t < nb; ++t) {\n            const size_t c0 = (size_t)t * b;\n            rows[t] = std::min(n, c0 + b);\n            cols[t] = rows[t] - c0;\n            if (t % size == rank) {\n                off[t] = acc;\n                acc += rows[t] * cols[t];\n            }\n        }\n        localElems = acc;\n    }\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Diagonal block factorization: D = R^T * R with R upper triangular,\n// column-major, in place.  Returns -1 on success, otherwise the index of the\n// first non positive definite diagonal element.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// `rowbuf` is scratch space of at least m elements.\n//\n// The block is small (it fits in L2) and sits on the critical path of every\n// iteration of the outer algorithm, so this is kept single threaded: an OpenMP\n// fork/join per column would cost far more than the update itself.  Row j is\n// gathered into contiguous scratch once so that the rank-1 update becomes a\n// pure unit-stride AXPY that the compiler can vectorize.\nstatic int factorUpperBlock(double* D, const size_t m, const size_t ld, double* rowbuf) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < m; ++j) {\n        const double d = D[j + j * ld];\n        if (!(d > 0.0)) {\n            return (int)j;\n        }\n        const double r = sqrt(d);\n        D[j + j * ld] = r;\n\n        for (size_t l = j + 1; l < m; ++l) {\n            const double v = D[j + l * ld] / r;\n            D[j + l * ld] = v;\n            rowbuf[l] = v;\n        }\n\n        // Rank-1 update of the trailing upper triangle.\n        for (size_t l = j + 1; l < m; ++l) {\n            const double djl = rowbuf[l];\n            double* __restrict__ col = D + l * ld;\n            const double* __restrict__ row = rowbuf;\n            for (size_t i = j + 1; i <= l; ++i) {\n                col[i] -= row[i] * djl;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return -1;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Generate the local block columns of the symmetric positive definite matrix.\n//\n// Mirrors the reference generator exactly: A = B * B^T + n * I with B filled\n// from rand_r(seed = 42).  The k-summation order is preserved, so the produced\n// matrix is bit-for-bit identical to the sequential version.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic void generateLocal(double* Aloc, const BlockLayout& L) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Flat list of the local columns (global column index + destination).\n    struct Col {\n        size_t gj;\n        size_t dst;\n        size_t nrows;\n    };\n    std::vector<Col> cols;\n    for (int t = 0; t < L.nb; ++t) {\n        if (t % g_size != g_rank) continue;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < L.cols[t]; ++j) {\n            cols.push_back({(size_t)t * L.b + j, L.off[t] + j * L.rows[t], L.rows[t]});\n        }\n    }\n\n    const long long nc = (long long)cols.size();\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 4)\n    for (long long c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        const Col& col = cols[(size_t)c];\n        const double* __restrict__ bj = B.data() + col.gj * n;\n        double* __restrict__ dst = Aloc + col.dst;\n\n        size_t i = 0;\n        // Four independent dot products at a time: preserves the summation\n        // order of each individual dot product while exposing ILP.\n        for (; i + 4 <= col.nrows; i += 4) {\n            const double* __restrict__ b0 = B.data() + (i + 0) * n;\n            const double* __restrict__ b1 = B.data() + (i + 1) * n;\n            const double* __restrict__ b2 = B.data() + (i + 2) * n;\n            const double* __restrict__ b3 = B.data() + (i + 3) * n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                const double v = bj[k];\n                s0 += b0[k] * v;\n                s1 += b1[k] * v;\n                s2 += b2[k] * v;\n                s3 += b3[k] * v;\n            }\n            dst[i + 0] = s0;\n            dst[i + 1] = s1;\n            dst[i + 2] = s2;\n            dst[i + 3] = s3;\n        }\n        for (; i < col.nrows; ++i) {\n            const double* __restrict__ b0 = B.data() + i * n;\n            double s0 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                s0 += b0[k] * bj[k];\n            }\n            dst[i] = s0;\n        }\n\n        // Diagonal dominance (A[gj][gj] += n).\n        dst[col.gj] += (double)n;\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Validation: compute L * L^T and compare against the original matrix.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic bool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig,\n                             const size_t n) {\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 8) reduction(max : maxError, relError)\n    for (long long ii = 0; ii < (long long)n; ++ii) {\n        const size_t i = (size_t)ii;\n        const double* __restrict__ Li = L.data() + i * n;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double* __restrict__ Lj = L.data() + j * n;\n            // L is lower triangular: entries beyond min(i, j) are exactly zero.\n            const size_t kmax = std::min(i, j) + 1;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < kmax; ++k) {\n                sum += Li[k] * Lj[k];\n            }\n            const double error = fabs(sum - A_orig[i * n + j]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i * n + j]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nstatic void printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_size);\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (g_rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (g_rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --- Node-local setup: one GPU per rank, CPU cores split between ranks ---\n    MPI_Comm shmComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, g_rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &shmComm);\n    int localRank = 0, localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(shmComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(shmComm, &localSize);\n\n    // Give every node-local rank an equal, disjoint share of the node's cores.\n    // This makes the hybrid code independent of the launcher's default binding\n    // (which often pins a whole rank to a single core).\n    {\n        const int nCpus = (int)sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN);\n        const int share = std::max(1, nCpus / localSize);\n        const int first = (localRank * share) % std::max(1, nCpus);\n        cpu_set_t* set = CPU_ALLOC(nCpus);\n        const size_t setSize = CPU_ALLOC_SIZE(nCpus);\n        CPU_ZERO_S(setSize, set);\n        for (int c = 0; c < share; ++c) {\n            CPU_SET_S((first + c) % nCpus, setSize, set);\n        }\n        if (sched_setaffinity(0, setSize, set) != 0 && g_rank == 0) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"Warning: could not set CPU affinity\\n\");\n        }\n        CPU_FREE(set);\n\n        if (getenv(\"OMP_NUM_THREADS\") == nullptr) {\n            omp_set_num_threads(share);\n        }\n    }\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        if (g_rank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));\n\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d, OpenMP threads/rank: %d, GPUs/node: %d\\n\", g_size,\n               omp_get_max_threads(), deviceCount);\n    }\n\n    if (n == 0) {\n        if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Computation time: 0 ms\\n\");\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    // --- Layout ---\n    size_t b = (n >= 2048) ? 256 : 128;\n    b = std::min(b, n);\n    BlockLayout lay;\n    lay.build(n, b, g_rank, g_size);\n    const int nb = lay.nb;\n\n    // --- Matrix generation (distributed, OpenMP parallel) ---\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n\n    std::vector<double> hostLoc(lay.localElems ? lay.localElems : 1);\n    generateLocal(hostLoc.data(), lay);\n\n    // Local element counts / displacements for the final (and optional\n    // original-matrix) gather.\n    std::vector<int> gCounts(g_size), gDispls(g_size);\n    {\n        int myCount = (int)lay.localElems;\n        MPI_Allgather(&myCount, 1, MPI_INT, gCounts.data(), 1, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        int acc = 0;\n        for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) {\n            gDispls[p] = acc;\n            acc += gCounts[p];\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> A;       // full result (rank 0)\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;  // original matrix (rank 0, validation only)\n    std::vector<double> gBuf;    // gather receive buffer (rank 0)\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        size_t total = 0;\n        for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) total += (size_t)gCounts[p];\n        gBuf.resize(total ? total : 1);\n        // Allocated (and first-touched) up front so that neither the page\n        // faults nor the zero fill land in the timed region.  The zero fill\n        // also takes care of the upper triangular part of the result.\n        A.assign(n * n, 0.0);\n    }\n\n    if (validate) {\n        MPI_Gatherv(hostLoc.data(), (int)lay.localElems, MPI_DOUBLE, gBuf.data(), gCounts.data(),\n                    gDispls.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (g_rank == 0) {\n            A_orig.resize(n * n);\n            for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) {\n                size_t src = (size_t)gDispls[p];\n                for (int t = p; t < nb; t += g_size) {\n                    const size_t rt = lay.rows[t];\n                    const size_t ct = lay.cols[t];\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n                    for (long long jj = 0; jj < (long long)ct; ++jj) {\n                        const size_t gj = (size_t)t * lay.b + (size_t)jj;\n                        const double* col = gBuf.data() + src + (size_t)jj * rt;\n                        for (size_t i = 0; i < rt; ++i) {\n                            A_orig[i * n + gj] = col[i];\n                            A_orig[gj * n + i] = col[i];  // symmetric\n                        }\n                    }\n                    src += rt * ct;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --- GPU / communication resources ---\n    cudaStream_t stream;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&stream));\n    cublasHandle_t handle;\n    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasCreate(&handle));\n    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasSetStream(handle, stream));\n    cudaEvent_t panelEvent;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&panelEvent, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n\n    double* dLoc = nullptr;\n    double* dW = nullptr;\n    double* dDiag = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dLoc, std::max<size_t>(lay.localElems, 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dW, b * n * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dDiag, b * b * sizeof(double)));\n\n    double* hSend = nullptr;\n    double* hRecv = nullptr;\n    double* hDiag = nullptr;\n    double* hBcast = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hSend, b * n * sizeof(double), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hRecv, b * n * sizeof(double), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hDiag, b * b * sizeof(double), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hBcast, (b * b + 1) * sizeof(double), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n\n    std::vector<double> rowbuf(b);\n    std::vector<int> counts(g_size), displs(g_size);\n    std::vector<size_t> srcOff(nb);\n\n    const double one = 1.0;\n    const double negone = -1.0;\n\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    if (lay.localElems) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dLoc, hostLoc.data(), lay.localElems * sizeof(double),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n    }\n\n    int failIndex = -1;\n\n    // Factor the very first diagonal block.\n    {\n        const size_t m0 = lay.cols[0];\n        if (g_rank == 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(hDiag, m0 * sizeof(double), dLoc, lay.rows[0] * sizeof(double),\n                                         m0 * sizeof(double), m0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));\n            const int bad = factorUpperBlock(hDiag, m0, m0, rowbuf.data());\n            memcpy(hBcast, hDiag, m0 * m0 * sizeof(double));\n            hBcast[m0 * m0] = (double)bad;\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(hBcast, (int)(m0 * m0 + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (hBcast[m0 * m0] >= 0.0) failIndex = (int)hBcast[m0 * m0];\n        if (failIndex < 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dDiag, hBcast, m0 * m0 * sizeof(double),\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n            if (g_rank == 0) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(dLoc, lay.rows[0] * sizeof(double), hBcast,\n                                             m0 * sizeof(double), m0 * sizeof(double), m0,\n                                             cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < nb && failIndex < 0; ++k) {\n        const size_t bk = lay.cols[k];\n        const size_t c0 = (size_t)(k + 1) * lay.b;\n        if (k + 1 >= nb) break;\n\n        // 1) Triangular solve for the block row k of every locally owned block\n        //    column t > k:  R[k,t] = R[k,k]^-T * A[k,t]\n        for (int t = k + 1; t < nb; ++t) {\n            if (t % g_size != g_rank) continue;\n            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDtrsm(handle, CUBLAS_SIDE_LEFT, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_UPPER, CUBLAS_OP_T,\n                                     CUBLAS_DIAG_NON_UNIT, (int)bk, (int)lay.cols[t], &one, dDiag,\n                                     (int)bk, dLoc + lay.off[t] + (size_t)k * lay.b,\n                                     (int)lay.rows[t]));\n        }\n\n        // 2) Exchange the freshly computed block row k among all ranks.\n        {\n            size_t sOff = 0;\n            for (int t = k + 1; t < nb; ++t) {\n                if (t % g_size != g_rank) continue;\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(hSend + sOff, bk * sizeof(double),\n                                             dLoc + lay.off[t] + (size_t)k * lay.b,\n                                             lay.rows[t] * sizeof(double), bk * sizeof(double),\n                                             lay.cols[t], cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));\n                sOff += bk * lay.cols[t];\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));\n\n            int acc = 0;\n            for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) {\n                int c = 0;\n                for (int t = p; t < nb; t += g_size) {\n                    if (t > k) c += (int)(bk * lay.cols[t]);\n                }\n                counts[p] = c;\n                displs[p] = acc;\n                acc += c;\n            }\n            MPI_Allgatherv(hSend, counts[g_rank], MPI_DOUBLE, hRecv, counts.data(), displs.data(),\n                           MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n            for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) {\n                size_t off = (size_t)displs[p];\n                for (int t = p; t < nb; t += g_size) {\n                    if (t <= k) continue;\n                    srcOff[t] = off;\n                    off += bk * lay.cols[t];\n                }\n            }\n            for (int t = k + 1; t < nb; ++t) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dW + (size_t)t * lay.b * bk, hRecv + srcOff[t],\n                                           bk * lay.cols[t] * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 3) Trailing update with one-step lookahead: the next panel is updated\n        //    and factorized first so that its broadcast overlaps with the\n        //    remaining GPU work.\n        const int next = k + 1;\n        const int root = next % g_size;\n        const size_t mn = lay.cols[next];\n\n        auto gemmBlock = [&](int t) {\n            const size_t m = lay.rows[t] - c0;\n            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(handle, CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_OP_N, (int)m, (int)lay.cols[t],\n                                     (int)bk, &negone, dW + c0 * bk, (int)bk,\n                                     dW + (size_t)t * lay.b * bk, (int)bk, &one,\n                                     dLoc + lay.off[t] + c0, (int)lay.rows[t]));\n        };\n\n        MPI_Request req;\n        if (g_rank == root) {\n            gemmBlock(next);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(hDiag, mn * sizeof(double),\n                                         dLoc + lay.off[next] + c0, lay.rows[next] * sizeof(double),\n                                         mn * sizeof(double), mn, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(panelEvent, stream));\n\n            for (int t = next + 1; t < nb; ++t) {\n                if (t % g_size == g_rank) gemmBlock(t);\n            }\n\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(panelEvent));\n            const int bad = factorUpperBlock(hDiag, mn, mn, rowbuf.data());\n            memcpy(hBcast, hDiag, mn * mn * sizeof(double));\n            hBcast[mn * mn] = (double)bad;\n            MPI_Ibcast(hBcast, (int)(mn * mn + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, root, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req);\n\n            if (bad < 0) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dDiag, hBcast, mn * mn * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(dLoc + lay.off[next] + c0,\n                                             lay.rows[next] * sizeof(double), hBcast,\n                                             mn * sizeof(double), mn * sizeof(double), mn,\n                                             cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n            }\n            MPI_Wait(&req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        } else {\n            MPI_Ibcast(hBcast, (int)(mn * mn + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, root, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req);\n            for (int t = k + 1; t < nb; ++t) {\n                if (t % g_size == g_rank) gemmBlock(t);\n            }\n            MPI_Wait(&req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            if (hBcast[mn * mn] < 0.0) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dDiag, hBcast, mn * mn * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (hBcast[mn * mn] >= 0.0) {\n            failIndex = (int)((size_t)next * lay.b + (size_t)hBcast[mn * mn]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));\n\n    bool success = (failIndex < 0);\n    if (!success) {\n        if (g_rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\\n\", failIndex);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --- Gather the distributed factor and rebuild row-major lower L ---\n    if (success) {\n        if (lay.localElems) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostLoc.data(), dLoc, lay.localElems * sizeof(double),\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n        MPI_Gatherv(hostLoc.data(), (int)lay.localElems, MPI_DOUBLE, gBuf.data(), gCounts.data(),\n                    gDispls.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (g_rank == 0) {\n            A.resize(n * n);\n            for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) {\n                size_t src = (size_t)gDispls[p];\n                for (int t = p; t < nb; t += g_size) {\n                    const size_t rt = lay.rows[t];\n                    const size_t ct = lay.cols[t];\n                    const size_t base = src;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n                    for (long long jj = 0; jj < (long long)ct; ++jj) {\n                        const size_t gj = (size_t)t * lay.b + (size_t)jj;\n                        const double* col = gBuf.data() + base + (size_t)jj * rt;\n                        // Column gj of the column-major upper factor is row gj\n                        // of the row-major lower factor.\n                        memcpy(A.data() + gj * n, col, (gj + 1) * sizeof(double));\n                        // Zero out upper triangular part.\n                        if (gj + 1 < n) {\n                            memset(A.data() + gj * n + gj + 1, 0, (n - gj - 1) * sizeof(double));\n                        }\n                    }\n                    src += rt * ct;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    // --- Cleanup of GPU resources ---\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hSend));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hRecv));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hDiag));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hBcast));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dLoc));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dW));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dDiag));\n    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDestroy(handle));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(panelEvent));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));\n    MPI_Comm_free(&shmComm);\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n\n        const double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n        const double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n\n        if (printResults) {\n            print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n        }\n\n        if (validate) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            const bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);\n   // offset of block t in the local buffer (owner only)\n    size_t localElems = 0;     // total local elements\n\n    void build(size_t n_, size_t b_, int rank, int size) {\n        n = n_;\n        b = b_;\n        nb = (int)((n + b - 1) / b);\n        rows.resize(nb);\n        cols.resize(nb);\n        off.assign(nb, 0);\n        size_t acc = 0;\n        for (int t = 0; t < nb; ++t) {\n            const size_t c0 = (size_t)t * b;\n            rows[t] = std::min(n, c0 + b);\n            cols[t] = rows[t] - c0;\n            if (t % size == rank) {\n                off[t] = acc;\n                acc += rows[t] * cols[t];\n            }\n        }\n        localElems = acc;\n    }\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Diagonal block factorization: D = R^T * R with R upper triangular,\n// column-major, in place.  Returns -1 on success, otherwise the index of the\n// first non positive definite diagonal element.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// `rowbuf` is scratch space of at least m elements.\n//\n// The block is small (it fits in L2) and sits on the critical path of every\n// iteration of the outer algorithm, so this is kept single threaded: an OpenMP\n// fork/join per column would cost far more than the update itself.  Row j is\n// gathered into contiguous scratch once so that the rank-1 update becomes a\n// pure unit-stride AXPY that the compiler can vectorize.\nstatic int factorUpperBlock(double* D, const size_t m, const size_t ld, double* rowbuf) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < m; ++j) {\n        const double d = D[j + j * ld];\n        if (!(d > 0.0)) {\n            return (int)j;\n        }\n        const double r = sqrt(d);\n        D[j + j * ld] = r;\n\n        for (size_t l = j + 1; l < m; ++l) {\n            const double v = D[j + l * ld] / r;\n            D[j + l * ld] = v;\n            rowbuf[l] = v;\n        }\n\n        // Rank-1 update of the trailing upper triangle.\n        for (size_t l = j + 1; l < m; ++l) {\n            const double djl = rowbuf[l];\n            double* __restrict__ col = D + l * ld;\n            const double* __restrict__ row = rowbuf;\n            for (size_t i = j + 1; i <= l; ++i) {\n                col[i] -= row[i] * djl;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return -1;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Generate the local block columns of the symmetric positive definite matrix.\n//\n// Mirrors the reference generator exactly: A = B * B^T + n * I with B filled\n// from rand_r(seed = 42).  The k-summation order is preserved, so the produced\n// matrix is bit-for-bit identical to the sequential version.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic void generateLocal(double* Aloc, const BlockLayout& L) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Flat list of the local columns (global column index + destination).\n    struct Col {\n        size_t gj;\n        size_t dst;\n        size_t nrows;\n    };\n    std::vector<Col> cols;\n    for (int t = 0; t < L.nb; ++t) {\n        if (t % g_size != g_rank) continue;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < L.cols[t]; ++j) {\n            cols.push_back({(size_t)t * L.b + j, L.off[t] + j * L.rows[t], L.rows[t]});\n        }\n    }\n\n    const long long nc = (long long)cols.size();\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 4)\n    for (long long c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        const Col& col = cols[(size_t)c];\n        const double* __restrict__ bj = B.data() + col.gj * n;\n        double* __restrict__ dst = Aloc + col.dst;\n\n        size_t i = 0;\n        // Four independent dot products at a time: preserves the summation\n        // order of each individual dot product while exposing ILP.\n        for (; i + 4 <= col.nrows; i += 4) {\n            const double* __restrict__ b0 = B.data() + (i + 0) * n;\n            const double* __restrict__ b1 = B.data() + (i + 1) * n;\n            const double* __restrict__ b2 = B.data() + (i + 2) * n;\n            const double* __restrict__ b3 = B.data() + (i + 3) * n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                const double v = bj[k];\n                s0 += b0[k] * v;\n                s1 += b1[k] * v;\n                s2 += b2[k] * v;\n                s3 += b3[k] * v;\n            }\n            dst[i + 0] = s0;\n            dst[i + 1] = s1;\n            dst[i + 2] = s2;\n            dst[i + 3] = s3;\n        }\n        for (; i < col.nrows; ++i) {\n            const double* __restrict__ b0 = B.data() + i * n;\n            double s0 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                s0 += b0[k] * bj[k];\n            }\n            dst[i] = s0;\n        }\n\n        // Diagonal dominance (A[gj][gj] += n).\n        dst[col.gj] += (double)n;\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Validation: compute L * L^T and compare against the original matrix.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic bool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig,\n                             const size_t n) {\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 8) reduction(max : maxError, relError)\n    for (long long ii = 0; ii < (long long)n; ++ii) {\n        const size_t i = (size_t)ii;\n        const double* __restrict__ Li = L.data() + i * n;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double* __restrict__ Lj = L.data() + j * n;\n            // L is lower triangular: entries beyond min(i, j) are exactly zero.\n            const size_t kmax = std::min(i, j) + 1;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < kmax; ++k) {\n                sum += Li[k] * Lj[k];\n            }\n            const double error = fabs(sum - A_orig[i * n + j]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i * n + j]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nstatic void printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_size);\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (g_rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (g_rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --- Node-local setup: one GPU per rank, CPU cores split between ranks ---\n    MPI_Comm shmComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, g_rank, disjoint share of the node's cores.\n    // This makes the hybrid code independent of the launcher's default binding\n    // (which often pins a whole rank to a single core).\n    {\n        const int CPU_ALLOC(nCpus);\n        const size_t setSize = CPU_ALLOC_SIZE(nCpus);\n        CPU_ZERO_S(setSize, set);\n        for (int c = 0; c < share; ++c) {\n            CPU_SET_S((first + c) % nCpus, setSize, set);\n        }\n        if (sched_setaffinity(0, setSize, set) != 0 && g_rank == 0) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"Warning: could not set CPU affinity\\n\");\n        }\n        CPU_FREE(set);\n\n        if (getenv(\"OMP_NUM_THREADS\") == nullptr) {\n            omp_set_num_threads(share);\n        }\n    }\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        if (g_rank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d, OpenMP threads/rank: %d, GPUs/node: %d\\n\", g_size,\n               omp_get_max_threads(), deviceCount);\n    }\n\n    if (n == 0) {\n        if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Computation time: 0 ms\\n\");\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    // --- Layout ---\n    size_t b = (n >= 2048) ? 256 : 128;\n    b = std::min(b, n);\n    BlockLayout lay;\n    lay.build(n, b, g_rank, g_size);\n    const int nb = lay.nb;\n\n    // --- Matrix generation (distributed, OpenMP parallel) ---\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n\n    // Pinned staging area for the local block columns, so that all host/device\n    // transfers of the factor are truly asynchronous.\n    double* hostLoc = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hostLoc, std::max<size_t>(lay.localElems, 1) * sizeof(double),\n                             cudaHostAllocDefault));\n    generateLocal(hostLoc, lay);\n\n    // Local element counts / displacements for the final (and optional\n    // original-matrix) gather.\n    std::vector<int>      for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) {\n            gDispls[p] = acc;\n            acc += gCounts[p];\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> A;       // full result (rank 0)\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;  // original matrix (rank 0, validation only)\n    std::vector<double> gBuf;    // gather receive buffer (rank 0)\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        size_t total = 0;\n        for (int p = 0; p < g_size; ++p) total += (size_t)gCounts[p];\n        gBuf.resize(total ? total : 1);\n        // Allocated (and first-touched) up front so that neither the page\n        // faults p < g_size; ++p) {\n            for (int t = p; t < nb; t += g_size) {\n                blkSrc[t] = acc;\n                acc += lay.rows[t] * lay.cols[t];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Block columns are shipped to rank 0 as soon as they are final, so the\n    // result collection overlaps with the rest of the factorization.\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> resReq;\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        for (int t = 0;          // index of the dW buffer holding the current block row\n    int pendingSend = -1; // block column finalized but not yet handed to MPI\n\n    // Copy a finished block column back to the host (overlapped) and remember\n    // that it still has to be sent to rank 0.\n    auto retireBlock = [&](int t) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evFin, streamC));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(streamR, evFin, 0));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostLoc + lay.off[t], dLoc + lay.off[t],\n                                   lay.rows[t] * lay.cols[t] * sizeof(double),\n                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, streamR));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evRes, streamR));\n        pendingSend = t;\n    };\n\n    // Apply R[r,r]^-T to block row r of all locally owned block columns t > r\n    // and start moving it to the host.\n    auto exchangeStart = [&](int r) {\n        const size_t br = lay.cols[r];\n        for (int t = r + 1; CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(evPack));\n\n        if (pendingSend >= 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(evRes));\n            if (g_rank != 0) {\n                MPI_Request s;\n                srcOff[t] = off;\n                off += br * lay.cols[t];\n            }\n        }\n        double* Wnext = dW + (size_t)(cur ^ 1) * b * n;\n        for (int t = r + 1; t < nb; ++t) // next block row and is therefore needed first.\n        auto gemmHead = [&](int t) {\n            CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasDgemm(handle, CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_OP_N, (int)(c1 - c0),\n c < share; ++c) {\n            CPU_SET_S((first + c) % nCpus, setSize, set);\n        }\n        if (sched_setaffinity(0, setSize, set) != 0 && g_rank == 0) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"Warning: could not set CPU affinity\\n\");\n        }\n        CPU_FREE(set);\n\n        if (getenv(\"OMP_NUM_THREADS\") == nullptr) {\n            omp_set_num_threads(share);\n        }\n    }\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        if (g_rank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));\n\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);","numLines":120,"startLine":250,"totalLines":838}}}
